texts.zh:
[planet.GetName]的最新气候报告带来了一项令人担忧的结论。奇怪的是，冷冻行星上的表面温度一直以惊人的速度上升。

如果我们无法确定生态系统迅速恶化的原因，这种情况可能会导致行星广阔冰川的灾难性融化。
texts.en:
The latest climate report from [planet.GetName] has come to a concerning conclusion. Inexplicably, the surface temperature on the frozen planet has been rising at an alarming rate.

If we fail to identify the reason for the ecosystem's rapid deterioration, the situation could lead to catastrophic melting of the planet's vast glaciers.

label.en: Find out why the planet is heating.

tooltips.zh: 这能是什么原因引起的呢？

texts.zh: [flooding_planet.GetName]上的温度迅速升高。我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]需要扩大他们的研究范围，以解决正在进行的局势所造成的新问题。
texts.en: The temperature on [flooding_planet.GetName] has risen alarmingly quickly. Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] need to expand the scope of their studies to address the new issues created by the ongoing situation.

texts.zh:
[flooding_planet.GetName]上温度的升级正在急剧加速。这引起了冰冷的表层之下出现了巨大裂缝，揭开了广阔的地下海洋。

幸运的是，我们的调查已经确定了这种现象的潜在原因。由于我们的存在，保护行星的独特大气盾已经开始变得出极其脆弱，并随时可能崩溃。采取严格的措施来遏制我们的生产力将最大程度地减少我们对生态的影响。这样做应该足够解决这个问题。
texts.en:
The escalation of temperatures on [flooding_planet.GetName] is accelerating dramatically. This has caused substantial fractures within the icy surface layers, unveiling a vast subsurface ocean.

Fortunately, our investigations have identified a potential cause for this phenomenon. Due to our presence, the unique atmospheric shield safeguarding the planet has begun to exhibit critical fragility and could potentially collapse. Implementing stringent measures to curb our production would minimize our ecological impact. It might be enough to solve the issue.

label.en: It is about time the ice age ended.

texts.zh:
我们在[flooding_planet.GetName]上排放量做出限制的尝试并未产生理想的的结果。我们在解决持续性生态危机方面的仅仅略有成功，由于海平面上升，地理意义上的低地正受到威胁。

目前，我们的人口中心仍然免受直接影响，但几乎可以肯定的是，行星范围的全面融化不可避免。
texts.en:
Our attempt to limit our emissions on [flooding_planet.GetName] has not yielded promising results. We have been only marginally successful in addressing the ongoing ecological crisis, and geographical lowlands are coming under threat due to the rising sea levels.

At present, our population centers remain shielded from immediate impact, but it is almost certain planet-wide meltdown cannot be avoided.

tooltips.zh: 停止全部生产活动直到找到解决方案。
tooltips.en: Halt all production until a solution is found.

texts.zh: [flooding_planet.GetName]上的气候迅速恶化。希望我们可以赶在局面无法扭转之前弄清楚原因。
texts.en: The climate on [flooding_planet.GetName] is rapidly deteriorating. Hopefully we can figure out why before it is too late to reverse the process.

texts.zh:
我们已经达到了环境突破。

燃料燃烧产生的无害副产物，与[flooding_planet.GetName]的细菌云接触时产生了奇特的副作用。我们现在知道，这些云通过遮蔽恒星光芒来保留行星的自然生物节律，这点至关重要。随着细菌逐渐开始减少，我们无意中加剧了排放的影响。

凭借这种新发现的知识，我们已迅速制定了措施以恢复平衡。
texts.en:
We have reached an environmental breakthrough.

The innocuous byproducts generated through the combustion of our fuels harbor an insidious side-effect when coming to contact with [flooding_planet.GetName]'s bacterial clouds. We now know that these clouds play a vital role in retaining the planet's natural biorhythm by working as a solar shield. As the bacteria slowly begun to diminish, we inadvertently exacerbated the effect of our emissions.

Armed with this newfound knowledge, resolute measures have been swiftly enacted to restore the equilibrium.

label.en: At last, the climate is stable again.

texts.zh: [flooding_planet.GetName]最后一个冰川沉入海洋，新时代随即开始。永霜冻土的消失揭露出一个宽敞的水下领域，那里面充满了未开发的资源。
texts.en: A new climatic era begins as the last vestiges of [flooding_planet.GetName]'s glaciers sink into the ocean. The disappearance of the permafrost has uncovered an expansive underwater realm, filled with untapped resources.

texts.zh:
在我们忽视迅速恶化的[flooding_planet.GetName]生态状况后，局势已逐渐陷入前所未有的灾难。

巨大的冰盖的瓦解导致海洋蔓延，带来了巨大的破坏和动荡。建造防洪大坝，我们可以保护其余的城市，但更多的不可预见的后果将会接踵而至。
texts.en:
In the wake of our neglect to address the rapidly deteriorating ecological state of [flooding_planet.GetName], the situation has spiraled into an unprecedented cataclysm.

The disintegration of vast ice sheets has given rise to sprawling oceans, leaving behind immense devastation and upheaval. By building flood barriers we can protect our remaining cities, but more unforeseeable consequences still linger on the horizon.

texts.zh: 随着[flooding_planet.GetName]行星的持续融化，在永霜冻土下有一个有趣的发现。无人知晓，无人开发且惊人丰富的矿物和稀有资源的极地宝库整静静地等待着我们。
texts.en: As the meltdown of the planet [flooding_planet.GetName] continues, a fascinating discovery was made beneath the permafrost. An astonishingly abundant polar reservoir of minerals and rare resources lies waiting, beckoning us with untold wealth and untapped potential.

label.zh: 我们中头奖了，赶快开采！
永霜冻土已经遭受了太多的痛苦了。

tooltips.zh: 我们不能冒着恶化局势的危险。
tooltips.en: We cannot risk worsening the situation.

texts.zh:
我们在[flooding_planet.GetName]上的极地开采站出现了令人不安的进展。工人们突然失去意识，为了安全起见，必须建立严格的禁止通行区域。

最初的调查表明，由于冰冷的环境被改变，休眠病毒的苏醒过来。这种苏醒的病原体的真实本性和特征仍然未知，这给我们带来了许多未解难题。它的传播性及对人民构成的潜在危险程度仍然不确定。
texts.en:
A disconcerting development has unfolded at our polar mining station on [flooding_planet.GetName]. Workers have succumbed to sudden bouts of unconsciousness, necessitating the implementation of a stringent no-pass zone for their safety.

Initial investigations suggest the emergence of a dormant virus, awoken as its icy confines were disturbed. The true nature and characteristics of this awakened pathogen remain uncertain, leaving us grappling with a multitude of unanswered questions. The extent of its transmissibility and the potential danger it poses to the people remains undetermined.

label.zh: 不要冒险。立刻给该区域消毒。
label.en: Take no chances. Sanitize the area.

texts.zh:
在[flooding_planet.GetName]极地地区的空洞深处，一个采矿团队发现了巨大的财富。在冰雪层的面纱之下发现了像冰川一样雄伟的巨大晶体。

这些非凡的结构，是在无数的岁月中在巨大的压力下铸造的，这证明了这里存在我们尚未发现的无限潜力。
texts.en:
In the hollowed depths of the polar regions of [flooding_planet.GetName], a mining team has made a discovery of monumental proportions. Veiled beneath layers of ice and snow, colossal crystals reminiscent of majestic glaciers were found.

These extraordinary formations, forged under immense pressure over untold ages, stand as a testament to the unlimited potential we have yet to uncover.

label.zh: 真是令人难以置信的发现。
